text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — we hit sustained export latency to Tempo this morning, looks like spikes on large trace bundles from mobile clients
Elaine Wu: ugh. same tenant?
Samir Patel: yep, tenant=alpha-app. spike correlates with >200-span batches and 30s export backlog
Jonah Reyes: are we batching on the agent side or the collector?
Samir Patel: collector does continuous-batching, but our exporter allocator is pegged. Tempos' ingest responds slowly which causes queue growth
Elaine Wu: can we route heavy-span tenants to Jaeger/Datadog fallback for short term? cheaper than throttling users
Jonah Reyes: we discussed a routing policy: small spans -> Tempo, large multispan bundles -> Datadog (sampling) or Honeycomb (slices). Need per-tenant quotas + emit metrics
Liz H: +1 for quotas. We need dashboard panels for "exporter backlog" and "per-tenant exporter latency". Product wants to see impact before we route away
Samir Patel: quick idea — introduce an ingest-gate that enforces token-bucket per-tenant and a dynamic allocator that redirects when backlog > threshold. Pseudoconfig:
```
ingest_gate:
  backlog_threshold_ms: 15000
  per_tenant_tokens: 500
  fallback_order: ["datadog", "honeycomb", "tempo-fallback-compact"]
```
Elaine Wu: love it. two follow-ups: 1) signal to the console UX so users see "your traces are being routed" 2) ensure we keep sampling metadata when we fallback
Roberto (infra-bot): deploy triggered: exporter-allocator/v2 -> canary (infra-cd). Logs: exporter-allocator: rate_limit=OK, redirected=12, dropped=0\nJonah Reyes: about sampling metadata — make sure we attach a routing_tag so downstream stores know original tenant and sampling policy
Liz H: UX note — add a per-route timeline in console showing routing changes, and a "why" popover with link to recent exporter errors
Samir Patel: agree. Also need alert rule: if redirect_rate > 20% for >5m, page oncall and open investigation
Elaine Wu: can we test with a synthetic tenant that sends 500-span batches? I'll stand one up in staging
Samir Patel: go for it. tagging @Jonah for collector config changes
Jonah Reyes: will add collector flag `--max-batch-size` and a feature flag to enable ingest-gate in staging. I'll post PR
Liz H: note for dashboards: group by export_target and tenant; retention view should show adjusted TTLs when fallback occurs
Samir Patel: ok pushing this as RFC tonight. Thanks all :thumbsup:
